preconditions.description: The number of lines of the conversation, T, is between 1 and 100, inclusive.
The string M is a permutation of the English alphabet.

preconditions.expression: Each sentence is non-empty and contains at most 100 characters
preconditions.description: Each sentence in the input has at most 100 characters and is not empty.

preconditions.expression: Each sentence may contain only lowercase letters, uppercase letters, underscores, and punctuation symbols
preconditions.description: Each sentence in the input contains only the specified characters.

postconditions.expression: For each sentence in the input, output its English translation on a separate line
postconditions.description: Each translated sentence should be printed on a new line.

postconditions.expression: Replace each underscore ('_') with a space (' ') in the output
postconditions.description: All underscores in the translated sentences should be replaced with spaces.

postconditions.expression: Each punctuation symbol should remain the same
postconditions.description: Punctuation symbols like dot, comma, exclamation, and question-mark should not be altered in the output.

postconditions.expression: Uppercase letters in Bytelandian remain uppercase in English, and lowercase letters remain lowercase
postconditions.description: The case of letters (uppercase or lowercase) is preserved in the translation.
